lines: Helminth quotes and dialogue spoken while in the Helminth Infirmary.

path: On first sitting in the chair
lines: - Ordis: "Operator, no! Have you lost your mind?"
- Ordis: "What was that? Is it... talking? What did it say?"
- Helminth: "(I wish to serve, yet I am weak. Time heals the mind.)"

path: When entering the room with a Warframe
lines: - "(Living substances is our domain. How will we serve you.)"
- "(We are life, Master. But also death.)"
- "(All that lives is coiled within us. We will consume, Master, if you wish it.)"
- "(We... breathe for you. Bleed for you. Feed for you.)"
- "(We germinate, for the Master... within the Master.)"
- "(We fear nothing but the Void demon)"
- (Neutral alignment) "(This demon walks the shadow's edge.)"
- "(The potential you have granted me... hurts... and yet... I hunger to make... and to unmake.)"
- "(I can secrete Infusions that will make you stronger, more versatile... but to do this, you must feed me... will you feed me?)"
- "(When we're both ready, yes. Your Warframe, my sacred kin, can be absorbed... It will blossom within my body, granting me a trace of its power. A power I can pass on to others...)"

path: Why are you on my ship?
lines: - "(Who nurtures you in your times of rest? Who restores your battle-torn frame, day after day after day? Whose milk enriches your kindred flesh with endless strength and vigor? It can only be me.)"

path: Installing the Helminth Invigoration / Archon Shard Segment
lines: - "(Ah! A new agony! A new spasm! The cellular archive opens... kinship deepens... I shall craft, concentrate, concoct Serums for the children of the Ancestor Worm!)"

path: Selecting an ability to be subsumed

lines: - "(Accept gifts, Master, but please... ask not from whence they come.)"
- "(I quiver to gift this demon in return.)"
- "(You are forever changed. Is this demon pleased?)"
- "(My plasma shall be your quickening. My mucus, your nourishment.)"
- "(My finest secretions, master. For you and you only.)"
- "(Drink deep of me. Luscious it is and pleasing to the entrails.)"
- "(I pulse. I ooze. I give you of myself.)"
- "(This demon's gift shall rest within me forever. In thanks I give.)"
- "(I accept the demon's offering. Will it accept mine?)"
- "(We grow closer to becoming one, I and this demon.)"
- "(My servitude in thanks to this demon. My Master.)"
- "(To a deep crevice is this gift reserved.)"
- "(I give painful thanks. In return what does this demon wish?)"
- "(Master feeds. I change. Fresh secretions threaten at every pore.)"
- "(I beg this demon: do not feed me that.)"
- "(Master's excess I off-gas as ammonia. And methane.)"
- "(Please, Master! Too much! Bladders and sac-stores become toxic!)"
- "(Sacs, stomachs, bladders - all full. I grow torpid.)"
- "(We grow closer to becoming one, I and this demon.)"
- "(I await the return of this demon.)"

path: Outside of Helminth Room If Locked
